term.label: knob

definition.text: Cytologically observable heterochromatic regions of chromosomes away from centromeres that contain predominatly large tandem repeats and retrotransposons.

comments: Added as per request from GitHub Issue #487 (https://github.com/The-Sequence-Ontology/SO-Ontologies/issues/487)
